title: O Savior, Let Me Walk With Thee * /
firstLine: O Savior, let me walk with Thee

lines: O Savior, let me walk with Thee
Please hold my hand that I may see
O Savior, let me talk with Thee
And thank Thee for Thy love;l
O help me Lord, forgive Thou me
From Thy throne in heav'n above.
O Savior, let me be with Thee
In that sweet home on high;
I'm longing for Thy face to see
In the sweet land by and by.
